correctness.rationale: For any q-grid separation δk, the two-cluster invariant submanifold with one oscillator separated from N−1 gives δdot=−gN H(δ). Full exponential attraction of all grid states forces H′(2πk/q)>0 for every k including synchronized k=0. For odd real trigonometric H of degree d<q, sum over q roots of unity of the derivative equals zero, contradiction. H(s)=sin(qs) is sharp: every grid Jacobian has relative eigenvalues −gNq and one global phase-zero eigenvalue. On the q-cover the flow reduces to first-harmonic attractive Kuramoto gradient ascent, whose nonzero-order-parameter mixed antipodal equilibria are unstable; zero-order-parameter equilibria are minima, and almost-all trajectories converge to synchrony, yielding exactly q^(N−1) lifts. The deck group permutes basins so each Haar share is q^(1−N). Independent exact root-sum numerical residuals <2.2e−13 for q≤15. Pure-harmonic covering/basin facts are prior work, not new.
